shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat vertical surface
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry relief-carved figures including an animal rendered in profile against a plain ground. Otherwise they are quite unlike: A is a dense, register-organised procession of many human figures with staffs and animals separated by rosette bands, rendered with modelled naturalistic detail, while B shows a single sparse, schematic creature with an isolated angular sign and long curving lines on an otherwise empty pillar face, with no registers, no humans and no repeated ornament.
